idle.action: Same three-quarter front view facing slightly RIGHT throughout. Subtle breathing idle loop: relaxed, inhale, relaxed, exhale. Both feet stay planted in identical positions and sword is held down. Preserve identical character size, hat, face, red coat and teal sash. No detached effects or ground shadows.

walk.action: CORRECT A FAILED WALK: do NOT draw the same extended right-side boot four times. Make FOUR VERY DIFFERENT leg silhouettes in a cyclic walk in place. Maintain the same three-quarter-front slightly-right-facing camera and pirate design. Frame 1: far leg (leg on viewer LEFT) swings FORWARD, its boot planted in front; near leg (viewer RIGHT) sweeps BACK with bent knee. Frame 2: feet CLOSE TOGETHER under pelvis, near knee lifted while far foot supports weight. Frame 3: REVERSE frame 1 legs: near leg (viewer RIGHT) extended FORWARD with heel planted; far leg (viewer LEFT) bends BACK. Frame 4: feet CLOSE TOGETHER under pelvis, far knee lifted while near foot supports weight. Frame 1 and frame 3 must be obviously opposite leg phases. Frame 2 and frame 4 are narrow passing poses, NOT wide striding poses. Arms counter-swing, hat and head consistent. Keep sword down and full body. Never duplicate any pose. No dust, shadows, scenery or detached effects.
